text:
Anya K: Quick sync — AcmeCorp private rollout (air-gapped) — can folks confirm status vs blockers? I tracked: FW rules, cert/KMS, offline installer, model artifacts transfer, and smoke tests.

Jess M: FW rules: approved by infra security this morning. Egress still blocked for all external storage. We have allowed these endpoints to the contractor NAT: 10.241.12.0/24 -> allow TCP 443, 22.

Samir: Re: KMS — customer will use on-prem HSM. Need to confirm our agent can fetch wrapped keys without outbound. Any PKI rotation docs?

Anya K: Samir — we need a design note. If HSM -> we support manual import of wrapped DEKs. I'll draft. Who owns the step? @Jess M?

Jess M: I can own the doc + PR for tooling. Plan: add an import flow to private-installer. Minimal UI: `redwoodctl key import --file wrapped-dek.tar` and a verification endpoint.

platform-bot: Deploy pipeline report: acme-onprem-installer:v1.4.2 build passed at 2026-03-16T14:12Z, integration tests: 62/68 passed (3 flakes, 3 failures).

ops-oncall: Re: integration failures — saw intermittent `timeout while fetching artifacts` in the artifact-puller logs. Excerpt: 
```
ERROR: artifact-puller: failed to fetch model shard 3 from storage://acme-bucket/shards/3: i/o timeout after 30s
```

Nate: That sounds like S3-over-VPN timeouts. Temporary workaround — we can rsync artifacts via scp through their transfer node. Command: `scp -r installer/artifacts/* acme-transfer:/var/tmp/artifacts/` then run `redwood-installer --offline /var/tmp/artifacts`

Samir: If we go offline-scoped transfer, we need checksum verification and signature validation. Add SHA256 and sigs to the artifact directory.

Anya K: Good call. Checklist for handoff to customer ops: 
- Firewall: 10.241.12.0/24 allow 22,443 (confirmed)
- Transfer: scp transfer node + contact person + creds (Ops owns)
- Keys: manual wrapped-DEK import (Jess doc)
- Installer: offline bundle + checksum + instructions (Nate to coordinate)
- Smoke: local health-check and sample inference run (we provide prompt set)

Jess M: I'll open a PR with the key import UI and add a `README_offline.md`. ETA EOD tomorrow. @Nate can you draft the transfer playbook and include the `sha256sum` example?

Nate: Yep. I'll drop a short playbook in docs/handbook and ping ACME ops with a timeline.

ops-oncall: One more thing — routing fallback: we need to enable `--skip-crash-on-missing-remote` for installer to avoid hard failure when external kv cache is unreachable. Current behaviour aborts deploy. Patch in progress.

Samir: Also verifying cert chain rotation: customer certs expire in 30 days per their inventory. We should include a rotation runbook in the handoff.

Anya K: Items assigned — Jess: key import + doc, Nate: transfer playbook + offline bundle, Samir: rotation runbook + cert checks, ops-oncall: installer fallback patch. I'll keep tracking in the private-rollout board and ping weekly.

Jess M: quick snippet I'll add to README_offline.md for health check:
```
curl -sS --unix-socket /var/run/redwood.sock 'http://localhost/health' | jq -r .status
# expect: "ok"
```

Nate: Pinged ACME ops (email + SSO request). Waiting for transfer node creds.

platform-bot: Reminder: canary window for onprem installs is this Friday 09:00-12:00 UTC. Please flag any conflicts.

Anya K: No conflict for us. Closing loop: please update the board cards when PRs/patches are merged. :pray:

Jess M: will do. :+1:

Samir: I'll stub the rotation playbook and share a link when ready.

ops-oncall: Patch for `--skip-crash-on-missing-remote` is up in review: https://git.redwood/infrastructure/installer/pull/412

Anya K: thanks team — next sync async unless blockers pop up.
